Captain's quarters same LENGTH as brigantine's, wheel INSIDE. Clear stair/ladder openings and supports; do not invent cannon counts, exact dimensions or stats. Warm dark weathered oak, restrained brass/iron, detailed natural timber joinery, high-definition realistic game materials. Six clear separated views of SAME hull: side elevation, front bow, rear stern with exact centered ladder, top deck plan, underside, one long side CUTAWAY showing actual interior levels and access. Bare hull only: absolutely NO MASTS, poles, sail cloth, rigging, flags, mounted cannons, crew or scenery. Empty sail sockets visibly distinct from permanent structure. Preserve modular outer railing system separately from fixed staircase safety rails. No text, labels, dimensions, numbers or watermark. Plain light studio background, neutral illumination, readable interior cutaway. Do not copy the input collage as a whole; show ONLY the requested Cavalier class. This sheet is a reversible reference study, not proof of constructed mesh or approved statistics.
